title: 가게 영업시간 안내판 읽기: 지금 문 열었어요?
summary: Learn 8 labels on Korean shop-hours signs, then use two sample signs to decide if you can visit or order at a given time.
objective: Learners will read a shop-hours sign and say whether the shop is open, or still taking orders, at a given day and time.
exercises: Answer in Korean (yes/no and why): [안내판 1: 카페 하루] 월요일 오후 2시에 카페 하루에 갈 수 있어요?
Answer in Korean (yes/no and why): [안내판 2: 엄마손 칼국수] 화요일 오후 3시 30분에 엄마손 칼국수에서 밥을 먹을 수 있어요?
Answer in Korean (yes/no and why): [안내판 2: 엄마손 칼국수] 금요일 저녁 7시 45분에 엄마손 칼국수에 들어가서 칼국수를 주문할 수 있어요?
Answer in Korean (yes/no and why): [안내판 1: 카페 하루] 토요일 밤 9시에 카페 하루에서 커피를 주문할 수 있어요?
Answer in Korean (yes/no and why): [안내판 2: 엄마손 칼국수] 이번 주 수요일은 공휴일이에요. 수요일 낮 12시에 엄마손 칼국수에 갈 수 있어요?
answers: 아니요. 주문 마감이 저녁 7시 30분이에요. 가게는 8시까지 열지만 주문은 못 해요.
네. 주말 영업시간은 밤 10시까지이고, 라스트 오더는 9시 30분이에요.
아니요. 공휴일 휴무예요. 평일이라도 공휴일에는 문을 닫아요.

sections.heading: 8 labels you often see on shop signs

items.text: the hours the shop is open for business.
the shop's regular day off. On signs it usually looks like 매주 월요일 휴무 (closed every Monday).
a break in the middle of the day, usually between lunch and dinner. The door is closed and you can't come in.
the last time you can order. The shop is still open, but it won't take new orders.
open every day of the year, with no regular day off.
open all day and all night.
weekdays (Monday–Friday) and the weekend (Saturday–Sunday). Many shops have different hours for each.

sections.heading: How to check a sign: 4 steps

points.text: Is that day a 휴무 (day off)? Check 정기휴무 and 공휴일 휴무.
Which hours apply, the weekday hours or the weekend hours?
Most signs use the 24-hour clock (15:00 = 오후 3시). Is your time within the opening hours, and not in the 브레이크 타임?
To eat or order, also check the 라스트 오더 (주문 마감) time. 마감 30분 전 = 30 minutes before closing.

sections.heading: 안내판 2: 엄마손 칼국수
sections.note: The two signs are made up for practice; they are not real shops or hours. The key point: 'the shop is open' is not the same as 'you can still order' (exercises 3 and 4).
